dslRule:
<!id: java.ui.moduleinfoclassfileeditor.id.no.source>
<!description: Replaces the generic ID_CF_EDITOR_NO_SOURCE with the specific ID_MODULE_INFO_CF_EDITOR_NO_SOURCE for module-info class files.
This reflects the refinement of editor IDs for module-info.class files without source code, as introduced in Java 9 module support.>
<!severity: INFO>

org.eclipse.jdt.ui.JavaUI.ID_CF_EDITOR_NO_SOURCE
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.ui.JavaUI.ID_MODULE_INFO_CF_EDITOR_NO_SOURCE
;;
summary: Replaces the generic constant `JavaUI.ID_CF_EDITOR_NO_SOURCE` with the more specific `JavaUI.ID_MODULE_INFO_CF_EDITOR_NO_SOURCE` to correctly identify editors for module-info.class files without source.
